opportunities.name: United flight search (origin, destination, dates, travelers, cabin)
opportunities.description: Search one-way or roundtrip flights on united.com by entering origin and destination airports, departure and return dates, traveler counts, and cabin class, then clicking Find flights.
steps: Open united.com and stay on the Book > Flight tab.
Select Roundtrip or One-way.
Click the From field, type the origin city or airport code, and pick the matching Suggested Search entry.
Click the To field, type the destination city or code, and pick the matching Suggested Search entry.
Click the Dates field, navigate the calendar to the departure month, and click the departure day.
If roundtrip, click the return day in the calendar.
Click Travelers, use the + / - buttons for Adults, Children (by age band), and Infants until the counts match.
Open the cabin dropdown (Economy / Premium economy / Business or First) and choose the cabin.
Click Find flights.

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor destination restaurant search with optional cuisine filter
opportunities.description: Search Tripadvisor for a destination via the Where to? box, open its Restaurants list, optionally apply a cuisine filter, and read the results.
steps: Open the Tripadvisor home page.
Click the Restaurants category button (or the More menu > Restaurants).
Click the Where to? search box and type the destination name.
Choose the matching location suggestion from the dropdown.
On the restaurants page, optionally expand the Cuisine filter, check the desired cuisine (e.g. Italian, Indian), and click Apply.
Read or scroll the restaurant results.
parameters: other filters such as outdoor seating (optional)

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search (venue, event, time window, accessibility filter)
opportunities.description: Find event parking on spothero.com by searching a venue, choosing an upcoming event, setting the entry and exit times, optionally filtering (e.g. Wheelchair Accessible), and reviewing the price list.
steps: Open spothero.com and click the Search box; type the venue name and choose the matching suggestion.
In the Events modal, pick the event (optionally first choosing the event date in Select Event Date).
On the results page, open the Enter After date and time and set the desired start time.
Set the Exit Before date and time.
Click Update Search.
Optionally click Filter, check Wheelchair Accessible (or another feature), and click Show N Results.
Read the listed garages and prices.
parameters: venue name (e.g. Barclays Center, Busch Stadium)

opportunities.name: United Explore-destinations search by origin airport (flexible dates)
opportunities.description: From united.com's Explore destinations map page, enter an origin airport, choose trip type and Flexible dates, and click Search to see cheapest fares on the map.
steps: Open the united.com Explore destinations page (Book > Explore).
Click the Flying from field, type the origin city or airport code, and pick the matching suggestion.
Confirm the trip type (Roundtrip) in its dropdown.
Click the Dates field, choose Flexible dates, and keep Cheapest flights in the next 30 days.
Click Search.
Read the price pins on the map.
